title.text: Ready to build your perfect form?

faqList.header: Is it difficult to set up a training evaluation form?
faqList.body: No! With Formester’s easy-to-use templates and AI form generator, you can create your training evaluation forms in minutes, no technical skills required.
faqList.body_markdown: No! With Formester’s easy-to-use templates and AI form generator, you can create your training evaluation forms in minutes, no technical skills required.

faqList.header: Will I need coding knowledge to customize the form?
faqList.body: Not at all! Formester's drag-and-drop builder lets you add custom fields like rating scales and text boxes without coding, making customization simple.
faqList.body_markdown: Not at all! Formester's drag-and-drop builder lets you add custom fields like rating scales and text boxes without coding, making customization simple.

faqList.header: Can I track responses in real time?
faqList.body: Yes! Our Analytics Dashboard shows real-time insights, so you can monitor training feedback instantly and make improvements quickly.
faqList.body_markdown: Yes! Our Analytics Dashboard shows real-time insights, so you can monitor training feedback instantly and make improvements quickly.

faqList.header: What if I don’t know what questions to ask in my evaluation form?
faqList.body: Formester’s AI Form Generator helps you create a training evaluation form in seconds by just describing your goal. It’s that simple!
faqList.body_markdown: Formester’s AI Form Generator helps you create a training evaluation form in seconds by just describing your goal. It’s that simple!

faqList.header: Can I integrate videos or other media into my training forms?
faqList.body: Absolutely! You can easily embed videos, images, and documents to make your evaluation forms more interactive and engaging for participants.
faqList.body_markdown: Absolutely! You can easily embed videos, images, and documents to make your evaluation forms more interactive and engaging for participants.

faqList.header: How secure is the data collected from my forms?
faqList.body: Formester takes data security seriously. We use encryption and comply with industry standards to keep your data safe.
faqList.body_markdown: Formester takes data security seriously. We use encryption and comply with industry standards to keep your data safe.

faqList.header: How can I share my training evaluation form with my team?
faqList.body: You can easily share your form through a link, embed it on your website, or send it via email, ensuring it’s accessible to everyone involved.
faqList.body_markdown: You can easily share your form through a link, embed it on your website, or send it via email, ensuring it’s accessible to everyone involved.

faqList.header: Can I automate follow-up emails to participants?
faqList.body: Yes! You can set up automatic email responses to participants, keeping them informed and engaged throughout the training process.
faqList.body_markdown: Yes! You can set up automatic email responses to participants, keeping them informed and engaged throughout the training process.

faqList.header: What if I need help customizing my form or analyzing results?
faqList.body: Our dedicated support team is here to assist you. Whether it’s form customization or analyzing feedback, we’ve got you covered.
faqList.body_markdown: Our dedicated support team is here to assist you. Whether it’s form customization or analyzing feedback, we’ve got you covered.

faqList.header: Will Formester help improve my training program over time?
faqList.body: Definitely! By tracking feedback and response trends, Formester helps you pinpoint areas for improvement and refine your training programs.
faqList.body_markdown: Definitely! By tracking feedback and response trends, Formester helps you pinpoint areas for improvement and refine your training programs.
